summary: Employee Management and Audit Log module testing completed successfully. All 19 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified: employee CRUD, permissions checkboxes, password visibility, status toggle, employee login, audit log tracking with filters.
seed_data_creation: Test employees created during testing are cleaned up automatically by pytest fixtures
context_for_next_testing_agent: Employee module fully functional. Permissions implemented: manage_clients, manage_purchases, manage_lives, approve_recharges, manage_shipments, manage_invoices, view_reports, adjust_wallet, view_statistics. Audit log tracks: login, create_employee, update_employee, delete_employee, and other actions. Employees cannot access /admin/employees or /admin/audit routes.

create_employee.details: Admin can create employee with name, email, password, and granular permissions (checkboxes)

view_password.details: Password stored in plain text (password_plain field) and visible via eye icon toggle

edit_employee.details: Admin can edit employee info and change permissions

status_toggle.details: Switch toggles employee status between active/inactive with toast notification

employee_login.details: Employee can login and receives permissions in response. Inactive employees blocked.

employee_dashboard_restrictions.details: Employee dashboard does NOT show 'Empleados' or 'Auditoría' modules (admin-only)

audit_log_tracking.details: Actions tracked: login, create_employee, update_employee, delete_employee with user info and timestamps

audit_log_filters.details: Filters available: Usuario, Acción, Desde (date), Hasta (date). Pagination working.

delete_employee.details: Admin can delete employee with confirmation

permissions_enforcement.details: Employees cannot access /api/admin/employees or /api/admin/audit-logs endpoints (403 Forbidden)
